message.content: {"reason": "The 0.689 validation accuracy points to underfitting of the current single-layer, d_token=32 FT-Transformer: 21 mixed fields with strong coupon×time/coupon×expiration/frequency interactions need more representational depth. Historical successful runs show that interaction-aware capacity is the main lever on this task, but the initial plan intentionally keeps the FT-Transformer and feature engineering unchanged, so the highest-leverage refinement is to deepen/widen the existing encoder and pair it with stronger regularization. These modifications belong in model_design (capacity) and training_evaluation (optimization/regularization and artifact persistence); data_processing stays untouched to honor the initial plan's leakage-safe FE direction.", "module": ["model_design", "training_evaluation"], "plan": {"model_design": "WHAT: Deepen and modestly widen the existing FTTransformer by changing defaults from d_token=32, n_layers=1, n_heads=4, ffn_mult=2.0 to d_token=48, n_layers=2, n_heads=6 (keeping head_dim=8), and ffn_mult=3.0. Keep FeatureTokenizer, CLS token, field positional embeddings, GELU FFN, final norm, and binary head unchanged. WHY: a single 32-dim encoder layer cannot represent the higher-order coupon×context interactions visible in this 8117-row tabular task; the 0.689 validation score is consistent with underfitting rather than overfitting. HOW: update FTTransformer.__init__ defaults and build_model defaults, and ensure the chosen architecture kwargs are stored in config['model_kwargs'] so predict_pipeline rebuilds exactly the same network. INTERFACE: preserve FTTransformer(cat_cardinalities, n_cont, **kwargs), build_model(...), forward(x_cat, x_num), and predict_proba signatures; config.json must still contain cards, feature_columns, cat_cols, cont_cols, and label_values.", "training_evaluation": "WHAT: Pair the larger model with stronger regularization/optimization: dropout/attention/FFN/residual/head dropout 0.12, weight_decay 2e-4, label smoothing 0.04, epochs 18, and patience 4; keep AdamW lr=2e-3, warmup+cosine schedule, mixup probability, batch size 256, and gradient clipping unchanged. WHY: the deeper/wider transformer has more trainable parameters and can overfit 8117 rows without stronger dropout, weight decay, and label smoothing; longer training with early stopping lets the second layer converge within the CPU budget. HOW: update _train_one defaults and the explicit call sites in train_pipeline; pass architecture and dropout kwargs through model_kwargs; build the criterion with smoothing=0.04; keep the OOF threshold search over 0.30–0.70 on training-only folds exactly as-is. INTERFACE: preserve _train_one, _predict_proba, train_pipeline, predict_pipeline, and the config keys threshold, fe_state, feature_columns, cat_cols, cont_cols, cards, cont_med/mean/std, label_values, model_kwargs; final refit must use the median best epoch from folds and persist the actual model_kwargs so fresh-process prediction loads the deeper model."}}
